name: Prisma Grinlok
tradeable: unranked only, no Forma or Catalyst

groups.activity: crack Void Relics, trade Prime parts for Ducats
groups.mode: squad of four for more reward picks

rows.label: Ducats
rows.note: trade Prime parts and blueprints at any Relay Ducat Kiosk except Maroo's Bazaar

conditions: The kiosk is open even when Baro isn't there, so bank Ducats ahead of his visit; his window is only 48 hours.
Bronze parts are worth 15 ducats, silver 45, gold 100 (25/65 for parts demoted from vaulted relics); 500 is about five gold parts.
bonuses: Capture and short Exterminate fissures (Mariana, Earth was named) are the fastest; solo with a speed frame runs 2-3 minutes.
Baro's once-per-visit Void Surplus (50,000 credits) has a 2% chance of 1,000 Ducats.

disclosures.title: other ways to top up
disclosures.body: Check a part on warframe.market's ducat tool first and only dump parts worth under about 5-10 plat. Varzia's 5 Ducats per Aya is a poor rate, worth it only for spare Aya.

rows.label: Prisma Grinlok
rows.note: arrives built and ready to equip; no Foundry step
rows.alt: or a TennoCon relay visit with Baro's Relay Ticket

conditions: Baro's stock changes every visit; the Prisma Grinlok turns up a few times a year.
Carry the 220,000 credits too, not just the Ducats.
MR 11 is needed to equip it, and to receive it in a trade.
